name: app
title: app
description:
Upgrade the Daily Mood Logger FastAPI app.
Add POST /log, GET /recent, DELETE /clear, and GET /moods routes.
Save logs as JSON in mood_log.json, and keep only the 50 most recent.
Each log should include mood, note, and timestamp.
